issues.concern: The English translation misrepresents the Japanese meaning. 「彼の口に乗せられて」 means 'I was deceived by his words' or 'I was persuaded by his smooth talk', not 'I was talked into it' in a general sense, which doesn't fully capture the nuance of being tricked or misled.
issues.suggestion: I was deceived by his smooth talk and ended up buying something expensive.
